title: Uruguayan Kielbasa Wrap
description: A flavorful wrap filled with roasted vegetables and Uruguayan sausage. Perfect for a quick snack or light meal.
instructions: 2. Slice the bell peppers and onion into strips.
3. Place the peppers and onion on a baking sheet and roast for 20-25 minutes.
4. Meanwhile, slice the Kielbasa into 1/4-inch thick rounds.
5. Place the tortilla on a baking sheet and toast in the oven for 5 minutes.
6. Warm the wrap by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
7. Assemble the wrap by placing the Kielbasa, roasted peppers and onion, and tortilla inside the wrap.
